newsitem.title: USA: Witco, Exxon may form white oils venture.
newsitem.headline: Witco, Exxon may form white oils venture.

text.p: Witco Corp said on Wednesday that it and Exxon Co U.S.A., a subsidiary of Exxon Corp, agreed to study the formation of a joint venture to manufacture and market white oils and related products in North America.
The companies said they expect a joint venture to be formed in 1997.

The joint venture, which would manufacture the products at Exxon's facility in Baytown, Texas, will include transfer of major equipment from Witco's manufacturing facility in Petrolia, Pa, the companies said.
The agreement would ensure customers no interruption in service and supply, they added.
Witco said it would continue to manufacture white oils and related products from its facilities in the Netherlands and market them in Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Asia and South America.
White oils are used in the manufacture of plastics, pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, and in food processing.
